characters.description: Rounded face with slightly chubby cheeks, short straight black hair with a small natural cowlick at the front, warm beige skin tone, slim-average build, default expression is a tired-but-endearing puzzled look with slightly droopy eyes and a small open mouth
characters.name: Tuấn
characters.outfit: Solid mint-green crew-neck T-shirt (no logos, no text), dark navy blue jogger pants, white socks with light grey slip-on sneakers

characters.description: Oval face with a bright wide smile, straight black hair pulled into a neat high ponytail, warm light-tan skin tone, petite and energetic build, default expression is cheerful and confident with wide round eyes and raised eyebrows
characters.name: Linh
characters.outfit: Plain white short-sleeve shirt tucked loosely into light grey wide-leg trousers, a coral-orange apron tied at the front with a big bow, light pink canvas sneakers
characters.personality: Practical and cheerful housemate who quietly has everything figured out and enjoys sharing small life-hacks without being preachy

rationale: The story clearly features two distinct characters: Tuấn (main) who drives the relatable problem arc across all 8 scenes, and Linh (supporting) who appears from scene 3 onward as the knowledgeable guide. Both are described with flat-cartoon-friendly features (simple shapes, clear silhouettes, distinct colour palettes) that differ strongly from each other — Tuấn in green/navy, Linh in white/grey/coral — making them instantly distinguishable as cut-out animations on a warm cream background.
